basic_info.description: Endless Potential – Make It Your Own! This three-story home offers a world of possibilities and an outstanding opportunity to customize and transform it into your dream space. The top floor features two bedrooms and one bath with stunning city views. On the main floor, you'll find one bedroom an additional bonus room, a bath, a formal dining room, a spacious kitchen, and a front living room – all ready for your personal touch. The garage boasts side-by-side doors with ample room for potential expansion or extra storage, the property also includes a room for a possible office. Plus, a large laundry room adds to the practicality of this charming property. With easy access to Muni, BART, and Highway 280, this home is perfectly situated for commuting and convenience.  Don’t miss out on this incredible opportunity to create the home you’ve always wanted!  Open House Sunday, Nov. 24th - 1:00 - 4:00 PM NO EARLY SHOWINGS - NO SHOW UNTIL 11/24
